Container.Name: TravStats
Container.Overview:
✈️ TravStats - Personal Flight Tracking & Statistics Dashboard
Track your flights, visualize routes on an interactive world map, and unlock achievements as you explore the world!
🌟 KEY FEATURES: • Interactive 2D/3D maps with flight paths and airport markers • 58 Battlefield-style achievements across 5 categories • Advanced statistics and analytics dashboard • CO2 footprint tracking and compensation suggestions • Boarding pass scanner with QR code support • Flight cost tracking with multi-currency support • Export to CSV, GeoJSON, KML (Google Earth) • Dark mode with theme persistence • RESTful API with JWT authentication • Mobile-friendly responsive UI
🔒 SECURITY FEATURES: • Auto-generated secure JWT secrets • Rate limiting on all endpoints • Duplicate flight detection • Production-ready with Pino structured logging
⚠️ REQUIREMENTS: This is an all-in-one container that includes both frontend and backend. PostgreSQL database is handled separately (see installation steps below).
📝 INSTALLATION: 1. Install PostgreSQL container first (postgis/postgis:15-3.4) 2. Set a strong database password 3. Install TravStats with the same password 4. Access at http://[IP]:[PORT]/ and create your account 5. Start tracking flights!
Version 1.0.0 - Production Ready ✅
Container.Requires:
🗄️ PostgreSQL 15 with PostGIS extension REQUIRED
STEP 1: Install PostgreSQL Database ===================================== Search for "postgis" in Community Apps and install: - Image: postgis/postgis:15-3.4 - Container Name: travstats-db - POSTGRES_DB: flights - POSTGRES_USER: flights - POSTGRES_PASSWORD: [CHOOSE A STRONG PASSWORD] - Port Mapping: 5432:5432 - Volume: /mnt/user/appdata/travstats-db → /var/lib/postgresql/data
STEP 2: Install TravStats (this container) =========================================== - Set "Database Password" to match PostgreSQL password - JWT secret will be auto-generated securely - Airport database seeds automatically on first start - OPTIONAL: Enable "Create Demo User" for testing (demo/demo123)
⚙️ OPTIONAL: External API Keys ================================ For automatic flight data lookup, add: - AirLabs API Key (free tier: 1000 req/month) Get at: https://airlabs.co/
🤖 OPTIONAL: Ollama LLM Server =============================== For AI-powered email parsing, install Ollama: - Search for "ollama" in Community Apps - Container Name: ollama (or travstats-ollama) - Port: 11434 (internal, no mapping needed) - Volume: /mnt/user/appdata/ollama → /root/.ollama - Set "Ollama URL" in TravStats config to: http://ollama:11434 - Models will auto-download on first use (~2-4GB per model)
📚 Full documentation: https://github.com/Abrechen2/TravStats/blob/main/README.md

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for accessing TravStats web interface (maps to internal nginx port 80)

Config.Name: Database Password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Format: postgresql://flights:YOUR_PASSWORD@travstats-db:5432/flights (Replace YOUR_PASSWORD with your database password from Step 1)

Config.Name: AppData Volume
Config.Description: Persistent storage for auto-generated JWT secret and configuration files

Config.Name: Seed Airports Database
Config.Description: Automatically populate airports database with ~8000 airports on first install only. Airports are automatically loaded on-demand when needed. Set to 'false' to disable initial seeding.

Config.Name: Create Demo User
Config.Description: Create a demo user account on first start. Username: demo, Password: demo123. Recommended for testing only!

Config.Name: AirLabs API Key
Config.Description: Optional: AirLabs API key for automatic flight data lookup. Free tier: 1000 requests/month. Get at https://airlabs.co/

Config.Name: OpenSky Client ID
Config.Description: Optional: OpenSky Network OAuth Client ID for flight lookup fallback

Config.Name: OpenSky Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional: OpenSky Network OAuth Client Secret

Config.Name: Node Environment
Config.Description: Runtime environment. Leave as 'production' unless debugging.

Config.Name: Cookie Secure Flag
Config.Description: Set to 'false' for HTTP access (no SSL). Set to 'true' only if using HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Backend Port
Config.Description: Internal backend API port. Do not change.

Config.Name: Instance Name
Config.Description: Display name for your TravStats instance (shown in UI)

Config.Name: Max Users
Config.Description: Maximum number of user accounts allowed. Set to 0 for unlimited.

Config.Name: Allow Registration
Config.Description: Allow new users to register accounts. Set to 'true' to enable public registration.

Config.Name: Frontend URL
Config.Description: Public URL of your TravStats instance (for email links, etc.). Update with your actual domain/IP and port.

Config.Name: CORS Origin
Config.Description: Allowed CORS origins (comma-separated). Update with your actual frontend URL(s).

Config.Name: JWT Expires In
Config.Description: JWT token expiration time (e.g., '7d', '24h', '30m')

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Optional: Ollama LLM server URL for AI-powered email parsing. Requires separate Ollama container.

Config.Name: Ollama Model
Config.Description: Optional: Ollama model name for text parsing (e.g., 'llama3.2:3b', 'llama3.2:1b')

Config.Name: Use LLM Parser
Config.Description: Enable AI-powered email parsing using Ollama. Requires Ollama container and model download.

Container.Changes:
### Version 1.0.0 (2025-01-24) 🎉 INITIAL PRODUCTION RELEASE
✅ Core Features: - Complete flight tracking system with CRUD operations - Interactive 2D Leaflet maps with curved flight paths - 3D Globe visualization with WebGL - 58 achievement system with progress tracking - Advanced statistics dashboard with charts
✅ Security & Performance: - JWT authentication with auto-generated secure secrets - Rate limiting (Auth: 10/15min, Lookup: 30/15min) - Duplicate flight detection - Structured logging with Pino - Production-ready error handling - Top-level error boundaries
✅ Data Features: - Boarding pass scanner (QR/barcode) - Flight cost tracking with receipts - Multi-currency support (EUR, USD, GBP, CHF) - Flight categorization (Business/Private/Vacation) - Export to CSV, GeoJSON, KML - OpenFlights airport database (8000+ airports)
✅ Quality: - 0 security vulnerabilities (npm audit) - TypeScript strict mode - Comprehensive API validation with Zod - Mobile-responsive design - Dark mode support
🔧 Technical: - Node.js 20 + Express + Prisma ORM - React 18 + Vite + TypeScript - PostgreSQL 15 with PostGIS - All-in-one Docker container - Health checks and graceful shutdown
